Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 2671 - 1%4 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
INTERLOCKED MILLING CUTTERS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 31 March 1964, after the draft finalized by the Small Tools 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Engineering Division 
Council. 

0.2 Interlocked milling cutters are generally used for slot milling. The 
cutters are very versatile in use as the width of the cutter may be varied 
between certain limits to mill slots having different tolerances or slightly 
different dimensions. The width of the cutter is varied by inserting spacers 
of suitable thicknesses between the two halves of the cutter. 

0.3 This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards being prepared to 
cover the requirements of milling machine accessories. Other standards in 
this series are: 

IS : 1830-1961 General Requirements for Milling Cutters 

IS : 1831-1961 Dimensions for Milling Cutters 

IS : 2169-1963 Specification for Milling Arbors 

IS : 2170-1963 Specification for Accessories for Milling Arbors 

IS : 2668-1964 Specification for T-Slot Milling Cutters 

IS: 2669-1964 Specification for Milling Cutters for Woodruff 
Keyslots 

IS : 2670-1964 Specification for Thread Milling Cutters ( Shell 
Type ) 

0,4 In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been 
derived from DIN 1891 : 1953 Slot Milling Cutter, Interlocked and Adjust- 
able, issued by Deutscher Normenausschuss. 

0.5 Wherever a reference to any Indian Standard appears in this specifica- 
tion, it shall be taken as a reference to the latest version of the standard. 

0.6 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing 



IS: 2671 -1964 

the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS: 2-1960 
Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values (Revised). The number of 
significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as 
that of the specified value in this standard. 

0.7 This standard is intended chiefly to cover the technical provisions 
relating to interlocked milling cutters, and it does not include all the neces- 
sary provisions of a contract. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard covers the dimensions and requirements for interlocked 
milling cutters. 

2. DIMENSIONS 

2.1 The dimensions and permissible deviations for interlocked milling 
cutters shall be as given in Table I. 

2.2 The sides of the cutter shall run true to the axis within 0*04 mm. 

2.3 For detailed dimensions of bores and keyways, see IS: 1831-1961 
Dimensions for Milling Gutters. 

2.4 All dimensions and details not specified in this standard shall be at the 
discretion of the manufacturer. 

3. DESIGNATION 

3.1 The designation of an interlocked milling cutter shall indicate: 

a) commonly used name, 

b) type A or type B, 

c) nominal diameter Z>, 

d) width b 9 

e) tool type, and 

f ) number of this standard. 

3.1.1 An example of designation is given in Table I. 

4. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS 

4,1 Interlocked milling cutters shall comply with IS: 1830-1961 General 
Requirements for Milling Cutters. 



IS: 2671- ISM
